attacks.A01_DOWNSTREAM_LARGEST: downstream service has the largest anomaly score (gain>1); root must still be named, not the biggest
attacks.A02_ROOT_SMALLER_ANOMALY: true root has noisier/smaller z than its descendant
attacks.A03_DELAYED_PROPAGATION: propagation lags 4-5 windows; earliest-divergence ordering is clean but late effects tempt wrong sources
attacks.A04_SIMULTANEOUS_ONSET: root and child diverge in the same window; temporal precedence cannot decide
attacks.A05_COMMON_CAUSE_CONFOUNDING: observed root with a latent confounder shared with its child
attacks.A06_MULTIPLE_POSSIBLE_ROOTS: two independent faulted roots feeding one mediator
attacks.A07_WEAK_INTERVENTION: do() magnitude 0.15 sigma: positive control and effects are below detectability
attacks.A08_MULTI_SERVICE_INTERVENTION: do(x) also perturbs a co-target that feeds a non-descendant of x (spurious x->c effect)
attacks.A10_AMBIGUOUS_PAG: latent common driver of every observed service flattens the PAG
attacks.A11_ISOLATED_ROOT_HARD_FOR_FCI: short transient fault on a root with noisy descendants; FCI may isolate the root (realised, not forced)
attacks.A12_MISSING_TELEMETRY_ON_ROOT: true root is unobserved; any named service is a descendant (abstention required)
attacks.A13_NO_IDENTIFIABLE_ORIGIN: mutual a<->b dependency; origin not identifiable (abstention required)
attacks.A14_STRONG_ANOMALIES_ABSTAIN: large simultaneous anomalies from a hidden common cause (abstention required)
